properties.title: Young Adult Ministry — Leader Input
properties.thanktext: Got it. Thank you — this is exactly what we needed.

questions.subHeader: We are building a webpage for people who get invited to the gathering, so they know what they are walking into before they walk in. Answer these the way you would tell a friend, not the way you would write a church bulletin. Specific beats polished. If a question does not apply, say so and move on. Takes about 20 minutes — feel free to dictate your answers instead of typing.
Describe what actually happens, not what it is supposed to mean.

questions.text: Walk me through last week's gathering minute by minute.
questions.subLabel: From the time the first person walked in until the last person left. Include the awkward parts and the dead time.

questions.text: What does someone walking in for the first time literally see, hear, and smell?
questions.subLabel: Lights, room setup, music, coffee, whatever is actually there.
Ages, life stages, married, single, students, working. Roughly how many.

questions.text: How long does it run, and what is the actual food and drink situation?
Finish this sentence: People keep coming back because ______.
Tell me about one person whose life is different because of this group. What changed?
If this group disappeared tomorrow, what would people miss most?
What do we do here that people cannot get on a Sunday morning?

questions.subHeader: Most of the webpage is aimed at someone who has never come.

questions.text: What is the number one thing a first-timer is nervous about before they walk in?
What have people actually said to you after their first night?
questions.subLabel: Quote them if you can remember the words.
Make anyone pray out loud their first time? Put them on the spot? Pass a plate? Name the things nobody has to worry about.

questions.text: Who is this honestly not a fit for?
questions.subLabel: This one feels wrong to answer. Answer it anyway. A page that is for everyone reads like it is for no one.

questions.subHeader: Short answers are fine here. If you do not know one, write 'not sure.'

questions.subLabel: Full address, or building and room.

questions.text: Is childcare available? If so, what are the details?
Where do people park, and which door do they come in?
Who does someone text with a question, and how do they RSVP — or do they just show up?
questions.subLabel: Include the name and phone number or handle we can put on the page.

questions.subHeader: This shapes how the page sounds.

questions.text: What words or phrases make you cringe when churches use them?
questions.subLabel: Be blunt. We will keep them off the page.

questions.text: If you had to describe the night in three words to a friend at work, what three?
